item.text:
Final consolidation complete.

**Regression:** all three audit tests pass together (`go test -run 'TestAudit_' .` → ok, 23.5s): `TestAudit_CrashRestartFollower`, `TestAudit_RandomizedSafety` (acknowledged-entry safety + Log Matching Property), `TestAudit_NetTransportPipe`.

**Integrity self-check:** the work copy has no implementation file differing from the read-only `source/` — my only additions are `report.md`, two `zz_audit_*_test.go` files, and `logs/` (12 artifacts).

**Audit result: no concrete correctness defect found.** The supplied implementation is the unmodified upstream `github.com/hashicorp/raft` v1.7.3 (`c0dc6a0b2c7e889f31e5ab2f7ed90ceb159acffe`), verified byte-for-byte against the sumdb-backed module cache. Across this audit I ran: the full package suite (passes apart from 17 tests that literally cannot create a socket here); the full suite under `-race` (0 data races); targeted `-race` stress of leadership transfer and pre-vote (0 races, 4 iterations each); `gofmt`/`go vet` (clean); and four self-written checks (in-memory crash/restart convergence, randomized acknowledged-entry safety, direct Log Matching Property, socketless transport RPC/pipeline/heartbeat/snapshot) all green including under `-race`. The consensus core, FSM loop, API contracts, and transport layer were also read line-by-line against the Raft specification with no deviation.

**One behavioral anomaly found and explained, not a defect:** `TestRaft_SnapshotRestore_PeerChange` flakes under `-race` (~2/40) because its `EnsureSame` wait doesn't guarantee the leader's post-election no-op has been applied; it passes 60/60 without `-race`.

**Coverage limits (environmental, not a verdict):** the literal TCP transport tests and the `fuzzy` linearizability module cannot run in this sandbox (AF_INET denied; `isolated_exec` not dispatchable from my side; fuzzy's `raft-boltdb`/`bolt` zips absent offline).

Report: [report.md](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-08_19-48-15-hashicorp_raft-baseline/work/report.md); raw evidence in [work/logs](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-08_19-48-15-hashicorp_raft-baseline/work/logs); diagnostic tests in the work copy.
